jobs.title: Junior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Your journey

ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.


Your typical day

  • Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
  • Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
  • Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
  • Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
  • Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
  • Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
  • Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
  • Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.


We look for

  • You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
  • You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
  • You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
  • You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
  • You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
  • You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
  • You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
  • You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.


What We Offer

  • A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
  • Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
  • Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)
  • €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket
  • EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution)
  • In-house German classes
  • Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications)
  • International team, English-speaking environment

jobs.description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the self-serve product experience for our SMB customers: small to medium brands selling on Shopify and beyond. The proposition for this segment is unbuilt, the squad is yours to shape, and you'll own the slice of ARR that comes with it. Working closely with engineers, designers, and AI researchers, you'll decide what gets built, why, and how it ships

Location: Paris, hybrid 3 days in the office. We offer relocation support

About the role

  • Own a real slice of the self-serve product. From idea to shipped feature, you will build and execute the roadmap that solves problems for our users.

  • Define the problem before the solution. Sharpen the user problem, then partner with design and engineering to ship work that feels effortless.

  • Turn AI capabilities into products people want. Work hand-in-hand with our researchers and engineers to convert new model capabilities into shipped features that move usage and revenue.

  • Stay close to the user. Talk to e-commerce sellers every week, and feed what you hear directly into roadmap decisions.

  • Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won’t need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

About You

  • You've shipped products you can defend in detail. Five+ years as a PM, with multiple launches where you can name the user problem, what you owned personally vs. the team, and the measured outcome.

  • You've built B2B SaaS for self-serve customers. You know the mechanics of self-serve growth, retention, and pricing, not just enterprise sales cycles.

  • AI has reshaped how you work. You use Claude or equivalent every day, for prototyping, testing with users, or automating the parts of the job that used to fill your calendar. The value you bring sits in strategy and direction, not in writing tickets.

  • You have demonstrable product taste. You can show specific work where the details matter and explain the calls you made, including the ones you'd make differently now.

  • You create clarity from ambiguity. Given a fuzzy problem, you take action rather than waiting for direction: you structure it, decide what matters, and move.

  • You're data-fluent. You pull, interpret, and challenge data yourself, and use it to form a point of view rather than confirm one.

  • You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a fully remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.

Nice to have: experience building creative tools or any product where craft and visual quality matter; an understanding of photography or videography; entrepreneurial experience (you've started, built, or run something).

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

  • You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a fully remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
The Role: What to expect

Idealworks builds industrial automation as a coordinated system — mobile robots, orchestration software, simulation, and increasingly humanoids and physical AI, working together in real production environments rather than as isolated pilots. Since our founding within BMW Group and our integration into Agile Robots SE, we've grown from a Munich-based robotics team into a global player.

As physical AI and humanoid robotics move from research into industrial deployment, our project landscape is expanding: today's programs span classic mobile robot fleets, next-generation humanoid platforms, and the simulation environments used to develop and validate both. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Project Manager to lead this kind of work end to end - technically credible enough to sit with R&D and hardware/software engineering, and organized enough to keep shareholders, partners, and customers aligned as programs move from concept to production.


Role Responsibilities: What you will do

Project & Program Delivery

  • Manage complex engineering projects across the full lifecycle — from scoping and planning through execution, integration, testing, and handover — spanning both software and hardware workstreams.
  • Define and manage project plans, milestones, budgets, and resourcing; monitor schedule, cost, quality, and contractual compliance throughout.
  • Identify technical, schedule, and commercial risks early, and drive mitigation and contingency planning across multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Plan and coordinate integration and validation phases (e.g., factory and site acceptance testing) across hardware, software, and systems components.

Cross-Functional & Technical Coordination
  • Act as the connective layer between product management, partner management, solution engineering, software development, hardware development, R&D, innovation management, and operations — ensuring each function's inputs and dependencies are captured and sequenced correctly.
  • Work closely with engineering leads on cutting-edge developments in mobile robots, humanoid platforms, simulation tooling, and physical AI to translate technical realities into realistic, defensible project plans.
  • Support innovation and R&D initiatives as they mature into deployable projects, helping bridge the gap between exploratory work and production-grade delivery.

Stakeholder & Partner Management
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for a diverse stakeholder landscape, including shareholders, technology and integration partners, and customers, tailoring communication to each audience.
  • Prepare and lead steering committee meetings, status reviews, and escalation discussions; ensure decisions are documented and followed through.
  • Manage claims, change requests, and contract or scope amendments in coordination with commercial and legal stakeholders.
  • Build long-term, trust-based relationships with partners and customers that extend beyond a single project milestone.

Operational Excellence
  • Track and report on project and portfolio KPIs (schedule adherence, cost/margin, quality, and stakeholder satisfaction) to leadership and shareholders.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of project management methodology, tooling, and best practices across the organization.
  • Support resource planning and prioritization across a portfolio of concurrent engineering projects.


Role Requirements: What you need to succeed

  • At least 5 years of experience in a similar role, or in a technical role such as engineering, software development, product management, program management, project management, or partner management, within the robotics industry or a domain of comparable technical complexity (e.g., autonomous systems, industrial automation, advanced hardware/software integration).
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional engineering projects that combine hardware and software development.
  • Strong technical fluency to engage credibly with R&D, software, and hardware engineers on cutting-edge topics in mobile robotics, humanoids, simulation, or physical AI, without needing to be the domain expert yourself.
  • A track record of managing external stakeholders e.g. customers, partners, or investors including steering committees, escalations, and commercial discussions.
  • Solid grounding in project management fundamentals: planning, budgeting, risk management, and reporting.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and business/executive audiences.
  • A degree in engineering, computer science, software development, mechatronics, robotics, or a related technical field is a plus.
  • Fluency in English required; German is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as project needs require.


Why idealworks

  • At idealworks, you will find an international working environment and become part of an experienced, open team where mutual trust counts. You will feel at home from the very first second!
  • Experience a first-hand start-up feeling and flat hierarchies with varied and responsible tasks that you work on independently.
  • Look forward to hybrid working model with 30 vacation days per year and various opportunities to balance your free time, family and job.
  • For your commitment to helping us achieve our mission, you will not only be rewarded with appreciation, but also with above-average pay including a bonus scheme and an annual personal development budget.
  • We offer exciting corporate benefits, an attractive company pension scheme and regular team events.
  • Our modern office is easily accessible by public transport, bike and car and offers numerous catering options for relaxed lunch breaks with your team.
  • Driven by our unique corporate culture, the five values "passion for results", "wellbeing", "personal growth", "trust" and "being and acting as one team" determine our daily actions and cooperation.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Managed Services and Support
jobs.description:
About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a cybersecurity and cloud services provider and a Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partner, dual certified in Application Security & Performance and Cloudflare One.

We design, implement and operate Cloudflare environments for enterprise and public-sector clients across Europe, the Gulf and Asia, with operations spanning Casablanca, Paris, Luxembourg, Dubai and Singapore.

Since July 2026, BRIXIO has been part of Equans, a Bouygues group company, combining our specialist Cloudflare expertise with the scale and reach of a major international organisation.

The Role

As BRIXIO continues to grow, we are looking for a Customer Success & Renewals Manager to take ownership of the commercial health and long-term development of our managed service and support portfolio.

This is not a technical support or project management position.

Your focus begins where implementation projects transition into long-term client relationships. You will own renewals, retention, account health and the conversion of completed projects into ongoing support and managed services.

You will develop a clear understanding of every account in your portfolio: the value being delivered, the health of the relationship, upcoming renewals, potential risks and opportunities for further development.

This is a newly created role with genuine ownership. You will have the opportunity to build the processes, governance and structure behind BRIXIO's customer success and renewal function.

What You Will Own

Renewals & Retention

  • Own the consolidated renewal calendar across Cloudflare subscriptions and BRIXIO service contracts.
  • Lead renewal planning and client conversations early enough to enable proactive decision-making.
  • Use subscription renewals as an opportunity to review usage, entitlement, service requirements and potential managed-service needs.
  • Maintain accurate renewal forecasts across the portfolio.
  • Build and maintain an account-health view using service performance, ticket trends, incidents, consumption and stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify accounts at risk and coordinate recovery plans with the relevant operational teams.
  • Review lost renewals and ensure relevant insights are captured and acted upon.

Project-to-Service Conversion

  • Own the conversion of completed Cloudflare implementation projects into ongoing support and managed-service relationships.
  • Work with Delivery Managers at project closure and hypercare exit to identify and progress conversion opportunities.
  • Maintain a structured pipeline of conversion opportunities, with clear status and next actions.
  • Develop commercial proposals in collaboration with the Sales Director and operations teams.
  • Actively manage prepaid and on-demand professional services contracts to support utilisation, client value and future renewal.

Client Governance & Account Health

  • Prepare and lead Quarterly Business Reviews for major accounts, covering value delivered, service performance, roadmap, risks and next steps.
  • Establish an appropriate governance rhythm for mid-sized and smaller accounts.
  • Maintain a portfolio dashboard providing clear visibility of account health, renewal status, risks and conversion performance.
  • Maintain appropriate account segmentation and adjust it as client relationships grow or evolve.

Account Growth

  • Identify expansion opportunities based on genuine client needs and signals such as traffic growth, new applications, evolving security requirements, additional business units or service consumption.
  • Qualify opportunities and work with the sales team to progress them, while directly managing smaller opportunities where appropriate.
  • Keep clients informed of relevant Cloudflare capabilities in a consultative and credible way.

Commercial Operations & Collaboration

  • Work across BRIXIO's international organisation, collaborating with operations and support, sales, architecture, pre-sales and finance teams.
  • Maintain accurate account, renewal and pipeline information within Zoho CRM and BrixioOne.
  • Establish scalable processes and ways of working for a newly created function.
  • Bring structure and visibility to the portfolio as BRIXIO continues to grow.

Your First 90 Days

Your initial priorities will be clearly defined:

  • Portfolio baseline: establish the position of every managed service and support contract, including value, renewal date, account health, stakeholders and risk.
  • Renewal calendar: create a consolidated 12-month view of Cloudflare subscription and BRIXIO service renewals.
  • Conversion pipeline: review recently completed and closing implementation projects and build a qualified project-to-service conversion pipeline.
  • Service consumption: take ownership of prepaid and on-demand service contracts and improve utilisation.
  • Governance: establish the Quarterly Business Review cycle and reporting structure for major accounts.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Service Delivery Management or a comparable client-facing commercial role within technology services.
  • Demonstrable experience owning renewals and retention, ideally with measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Experience within an MSP, managed security provider, systems integrator, consultancy or SaaS environment involving recurring revenue.
  • Confidence working with contracts, pricing, service entitlements and SLAs.
  • Experience with vendor subscriptions or licence renewals within a reseller or indirect model would be a strong advantage.
  • Experience creating or developing a customer-success, renewal or account-management function would also be highly valued.

Technical Understanding

You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable having credible conversations with security and infrastructure stakeholders.

Ideally, you will have:

  • A working understanding of DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation and Zero Trust, or the ability to develop this knowledge quickly.
  • The ability to interpret service reports and analytics and translate them into meaningful client conversations.
  • Confidence working alongside technical delivery, operations and architecture teams.

Cloudflare product training, access to Cloudflare University and funded certification will be provided.

Languages

Full professional fluency in French and English is essential, both written and spoken.

You will work with French-speaking European accounts as well as enterprise and public-sector clients across the Gulf, including leading governance conversations and preparing client-facing material in both languages.

Arabic is a significant advantage for the Gulf portfolio.

What Will Help You Succeed

You are likely to thrive in this role if you are:

  • Highly organised and systematic, with the ability to maintain visibility across a significant portfolio of accounts.
  • Commercially confident and comfortable discussing renewals, pricing and scope with clients.
  • Credible with both client-side technical stakeholders and internal operations teams.
  • Able to identify account risk proactively rather than waiting for a client to escalate.
  • Self-directed and comfortable building structure where no established playbook currently exists.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured through tangible commercial and customer outcomes, including:

  • Strong net revenue retention across the managed service and support portfolio.
  • Increased conversion of completed implementation projects into ongoing services.
  • Renewals managed proactively, with clear forecasting and no avoidable lapses.
  • Better utilisation of prepaid and on-demand service entitlements.
  • Effective governance and business-review cycles across key accounts.
  • Clear, accurate and up-to-date visibility of portfolio health, risk and opportunity.

Why BRIXIO?

  • Join one of a select number of Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partners, working closely with Cloudflare engineering and support teams.
  • Be part of Equans and the Bouygues group, combining specialist expertise with the stability and opportunities of a major international organisation.
  • Work with substantial enterprise and public-sector clients across Europe and the Gulf.
  • Build and shape a function from the ground up rather than simply inheriting an established process.
  • Develop towards broader account leadership, scaled customer success or opportunities within the wider Equans commercial organisation.

jobs.title: MSP Engineer, Network and Security - Rotating shifts
jobs.description:
About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a cybersecurity and cloud services provider and a Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partner, dual certified in Core Services and Cloudflare One.

We design, implement and operate Cloudflare environments for enterprise and public-sector clients across the Gulf, Europe and Asia, with offices in Casablanca, Paris, Luxembourg, Dubai and Singapore.

Since July 2026, BRIXIO has been part of Equans, a Bouygues group company, combining our specialist focus and technical expertise with the scale, stability and career opportunities of a major international organisation.

The Role

BRIXIO is building a genuine managed services capability — not simply a ticket queue.

As an MSP Engineer, you will operate client Cloudflare environments during your shift, combining reactive incident management with structured, proactive engineering.

You will detect and investigate issues before clients report them, resolve incidents within committed service levels, execute production changes under controlled processes, and carry out proactive activities designed to improve security, performance and service stability over time.

Managed services and support are delivered by the same team. This means your role spans both incident response and scheduled proactive work, with proactive engineering time protected within the rota rather than fitted around ticket volume.

You will be the technical responder on shift, but you will not carry an account alone. Client relationship management and reporting are owned by the Delivery Manager, while technical arbitration sits with the MSP & Support Lead.

There is no expectation to be reachable outside your scheduled shift.

Working Pattern

BRIXIO operates a follow-the-sun model across its teams in Morocco and the Philippines, designed around client demand and defined service coverage windows.

Early Shift

09:00–17:00 Morocco time

Provides full coverage during the core client peak window and is named on relevant client contracts.

Late Shift

15:00–23:00 Morocco time

Extends coverage across the peak window and includes an overlap and structured handover with the Early Shift.

Weekend Rotation

Weekend coverage is shared across the team on a reduced rotation. Sunday forms part of the service window for Gulf clients.

Shifts are managed through a published rota issued in advance, so you will know your schedule ahead of time.

Each shift change includes a 30-minute overlap and written handover, ensuring that engineers do not inherit undocumented situations.

Under the current operating model, Gulf night coverage is provided by colleagues in the Philippines within their normal working day. Shift patterns may evolve as the team and client base grow, with any changes discussed with the team in advance.

Weekend rotation is compensated in accordance with Moroccan law and Equans policy.

What You Will Do

Service Operations

  • Staff the client intake channel during your shift, qualify and triage incoming requests, and own first response within committed service levels.
  • Diagnose and resolve incidents across the Cloudflare stack, including WAF, DDoS mitigation, rate limiting, bot management, CDN and caching, DNS, TLS, load balancing, Zero Trust and Workers.
  • Qualify monitoring alerts, act on them using documented runbooks and create tickets where required.
  • Escalate appropriately and early to senior engineers, the MSP & Support Lead and Cloudflare Support in accordance with the escalation matrix.
  • Maintain accurate ticket records in Jira, including detection source, priority and timestamps, supporting accurate service-level reporting.

Change Execution

  • Execute production configuration changes under formal change control, including four-eyes validation and a documented rollback plan before deployment.
  • Provide named technical coverage during declared client go-live windows, including pre-go-live validation and active monitoring following cutover.
  • Maintain Cloudflare configuration as code using Terraform and version control.
  • Investigate and resolve configuration drift identified through automated nightly comparisons.
  • Ensure production changes are properly documented and traceable.

Proactive Engineering

  • Deliver scheduled proactive activities including configuration and security-posture audits, false-positive analysis, cache and rate-limit calibration, DNS and certificate hygiene, and unused-rule cleanup.
  • Analyse traffic and security telemetry using Cloudflare Analytics, GraphQL API and log data to identify potential problems before they affect clients.
  • Recommend and implement security and performance improvements and demonstrate their impact.
  • Contribute to root-cause analysis following major incidents.
  • Identify recurring causes and raise them through the problem-management process so they can be eliminated rather than repeatedly resolved.

Collaboration & Knowledge

  • Work closely with client NOC and security teams, including participation in operational channels and major incident bridges where BRIXIO is integrated with the client's teams.
  • Write and maintain runbooks, Standard Operating Procedures and configuration documentation in Confluence.
  • Support BRIXIO's professional services and implementation teams during escalations and handovers into managed service.
  • Actively share technical knowledge across the team to reduce dependency on individual engineers.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Technical Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in network, security or cloud operations.
  • Experience within managed services, NOC or SOC environments is a strong advantage.
  • Solid working knowledge of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, proxies, caching and CDN mechanics.
  • Practical Cloudflare experience across WAF, DDoS mitigation, rate limiting, bot management, CDN and DNS.
  • Where Cloudflare experience is partial, BRIXIO will fund Cloudflare certification, which you will be expected to complete within the first six months.
  • Confidence using diagnostic tools including curl, dig, traceroute, browser developer tools and HAR analysis.
  • Experience with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with Git/version control.
  • Scripting capability using Python or Bash.
  • Understanding of web application architecture and application-security fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with Jira Service Management and ITIL-aligned incident, change and problem-management processes.
  • Exposure to observability and monitoring platforms.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP is an advantage.

Languages

Full professional fluency in both French and English is a hard requirement.

You will handle incidents both in writing and verbally with French- and English-speaking enterprise clients, including during high-pressure situations. You will also prepare client-facing incident and change records in both languages.

Both French and English will be assessed during the interview process.

Arabic is a significant advantage when supporting BRIXIO's Gulf accounts.

How You Work

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Calm and methodical when working under incident pressure.
  • Disciplined about escalation rather than improvising when the situation requires additional expertise.
  • Serious about documentation and maintaining accurate technical records.
  • Able to explain technical situations clearly to non-technical stakeholders in either French or English.
  • Comfortable acknowledging what they do not know and finding the right answer.
  • Reliable within a rotating shift environment and disciplined about providing clean handovers to colleagues.
  • Comfortable working remotely within a distributed international team spanning Morocco, the Philippines, France and the Gulf.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

  • Increasing numbers of issues are detected and resolved proactively before clients report them.
  • Service-level commitments are consistently met, with any breaches accurately documented and understood.
  • Recurring incidents are progressively eliminated, reducing reactive workload over time.
  • Production changes are executed safely, with rollback plans prepared even when they are not needed.
  • Shift handovers are clean, tickets are accurate and runbooks remain current.
  • Clients develop confidence in the engineers operating their environments.
  • Proactive engineering contributes measurably to improved security, performance and service stability.

Why BRIXIO?

  • Join one of a select number of Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partners, working directly with Cloudflare engineering and support teams.
  • Be part of Equans and the Bouygues group, with the stability, scale and career mobility of a major international organisation.
  • Develop genuine Cloudflare depth through access to Cloudflare University, partner-only training and funded certification.
  • Join a managed service designed around defined processes, published rotas, protected proactive engineering time and no expectation of being reachable outside your shift.
  • Develop towards Senior MSP Engineering, Professional Services Implementation, Solution Architecture or Service Delivery Management.
  • Work in an environment where automation is part of the engineering role, with engineers encouraged to contribute to and improve BRIXIO's internal tooling.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Project Manager, most of your implementations are not multi-year global programs. They are for companies that want blp running in their finance or supply chain organization within weeks, and who want somebody who knows what they are doing to take them through it. You are that person. You run the kick-off, work with them on scope and process, configure blp, coordinate the integration, take them through testing, and get them across the line at go-live.

You work in three modes, and many of our Project Managers move between them:

  • Guided onboarding for our commercial customers: you run configuration days for several customers at once, guide them while they configure, and answer the questions that come up.

  • Leading yourself on enterprise customers: you own the project end to end, including the sponsor meetings.

  • Alongside a Senior Project Manager on our largest programs, where you take a country, an entity or a workstream and own it.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

jobs.title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Agora Industry

Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.  Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
 
Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 
 
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.


Your responsibilities include

  • Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
  • Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
  • Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
  • Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.  
  • Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
  • Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
  • Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
  • Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
  • Actively contributing to internal discussions.
  • Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
  • As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
  • As Project Manager, the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.


We are looking for

  • A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar 
  • As Project Officer: Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems.
  • As Project Manager: At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years specifically in the field of biomass
  • A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies. 
  • Solid knowledge of the farming and forestry sectors.
  • Familiarity with agricultural systems and ideally forest systems in different world regions is a plus. 
  • Good background understanding of industrial transformation is a plus.
  • Experience with Life-Cycle Assessment is a plus. 
  • Familiarity with sustainable biomass certification and deforestation-free frameworks is a plus.
  • Strong networking skills and the ability to engage with business, industry associations, research partners and policy makers.
  • A creative and result-oriented mind, capable of developing new ideas and proposals with a view to having impact.
  • Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written; track-record in writing high quality documents.
  • Full command of the English language in reading and writing, knowledge of other languages is a plus.

  • Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

  • Balance life and work with a hybrid model (40% remote) and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules.

jobs.description:
Über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du willst Digitalisierung dort vorantreiben, wo sie gesellschaftlich wirklich zählt? Als Senior Project Manager (all genders) gestaltest und steuerst du anspruchsvolle digitale Verwaltungsprojekte rund um Migration & Inneres. Du bringst Kund:innen, Fachlichkeit und Technologie zusammen und machst aus komplexen Anforderungen digitale Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du realisierst anspruchsvolle IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte von gesellschaftlicher Relevanz mit besonderem Fokus auf die Fachthemen Migration & Inneres – agil oder hybrid.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte über die gesamte Projektlaufzeit und steuerst Scope, Time, Budget, Qualität und Risiken.
  • Du arbeitest mit interdisziplinäre Projektteams, in unterschiedlichen technologischen Kontexten – von digitalen Verwaltungsleistungen und Fachanwendungen über Content- und Formular-Management-Systeme bis hin zu individuellen IT-Lösungen zusammen und sorgst für eine strukturierte und verlässliche Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Projekts.
  • Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst du interne und externe Stakeholder und arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen aus der öffentlichen Verwaltung zusammen. Gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams übersetzt du die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen in tragfähige IT-Lösungen und digitale Prozesse und begleitest deren Umsetzung von der Konzeption bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live.
  • Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen bei Fragestellungen rund um die digitale Transformation und erkennst dabei auch Potenziale für die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Projekte und Lösungen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von  Entwicklungs- oder Digitalisierungsprojekten und kannst Projekte eigenständig und Ende-zu-Ende steuern.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung interdisziplinärer Projektteams und übernimmst sicher Verantwortung für Scope, Budget, Time,  Qualität und Risiken.
  • Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit Digitalisierungsprojekten der öffentlichen Verwaltung und/oder einen fachlichen Bezug zu den Themen Migration & Inneres mit.
  • Du kennst und schätzt die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Kund:innen und verstehst Projektmanagement als kundenorientierte Delivery-Rolle und bewegst dich mit deinem Kommunikationsgeschick souverän auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen der Projektorganisation.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit agilen und/oder klassischen Projektmethoden. Erfahrung mit skalierten agilen Vorgehensweisen oder hybriden Projekt-Set-ups ist ein Plus.
  • Idealerweise verfügst du über eine relevante Projektmanagement- oder Agile-Zertifizierung, z. B. PRINCE2, PMI, Scrum PSM/PSPO
  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium bildet die fachliche Grundlage für deine Tätigkeit bei uns.
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.
 
Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.

Anne Kroll

jobs.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 
 

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience.By joining us as a Senior Data Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in large projects, bringing your business sense and analytical thinking to help us meet our high delivery standards.

 

HOW you will contribute to the company

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Acquisition (5+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people).

  • You will proactively use data to identify opportunities to grow our business or improve our processes.

  • You will be a real sparring partner for Sales & Operation leaders, feed their strategy by anticipating the most important business questions, and leverage your data & statistical skills to answer them.

  • You will steer decision‑making in your business area through rigorous analyses, navigating ambiguity and collaborating across domains when needed.

  • You will drive our self-service approach to analytics, by understanding our colleague’s needs in their use of data, and promoting a data driven culture. The Science & Analytics team is also fully in charge of creating data models in the Data Warehouse (using dbt).

  • You will contribute to shaping the Data Engineering roadmap to deliver the best experience for your colleagues on the data platform.

 

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane

Within one month:

  • You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.

  • You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.

  • You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of our product and operations.

Within 3 months:

  • You will be fully in charge of supporting your area of the business, prioritizing your tasks with decision makers.

  • You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT).

  • You will contribute to larger cross-company projects.

Within 6 months:

  • You will proactively contribute to the team’s roadmap.

  • You will work with engineers and data practitioners on improving our stack and data platform.

  • You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.

And beyond: the data team will continue growing with the company

Which means:

  • Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members

  • Increased accountability in project leadership

  • Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.

 

Who are we looking for?

You’re the right candidate if you:

  • Have had previous experiences as Data Analyst, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years)

  • Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools

  • Are comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders beyond the data team

  • You have a strong business acumen and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders

  • Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly

  • Are Fluent in French & English

 

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager

  • A case study interview to discuss a topic closely related to one of our priorities (60 min)

  • A past project interview to hear about your experience (60 min)

  • An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (45 min)

 

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

jobs.title: Tech Lead: AI & Innovation
jobs.description:
↳ Alternative locations: Barcelona, Frankfurt a.M., Leipzig, Sevilla

Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies – "Vicos". We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing.

Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies.

Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SME. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market.

Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.

Given its ambitious and transformative purpose, our platform is highly complex (though easy use). Developing it further takes engineers who combine technical excellence, pragmatic judgement and entrepreneurial spirit. The Tech Lead: AI & Innovation we are looking for embodies these qualities in his or her leadership. He or she is up for making a major contribution to our company and to our society.

Tasks

  • As the most senior engineer, you'll lead, grow and enable a small team of (forward deployed) engineers: hire, onboard, coach and make every engineer successful in their role.
  • Own the technical direction and technology decisions for Vicoland. Set the architecture across the stack, from frontend to infrastructure, and make sure what we build is scalable, robust and maintainable.
  • Stay hands-on: contribute code yourself, build prototypes, and use AI to aggressively ship high-quality software alongside your team.
  • Translate business needs into technical roadmaps in close cooperation with Business Development, Product and other stakeholders. Prioritize, scope and make trade-offs explicit.
  • Own delivery end-to-end for your team: design, development, QA, deployment and production monitoring, with clear engineering standards and quality gates.
  • Establish how we build with AI: best practices for context engineering, model selection, evaluation, tracing and observability, so that quality is measured, not assumed.
  • Run architectural discussions, code reviews and retrospectives; create a culture of ownership, constructive challenge and continuous learning.
  • Act as a sparring partner to the Chief Product Officer and the leadership team on technology strategy, build-vs-buy decisions and team setup.

Requirements

  • Have proven people leadership experience: you have led an engineering team (ideally 3+ engineers), including hiring, performance conversations, career development and coaching.
  • Have excelled somewhere, somehow through an impactful technical contribution, one which we can talk about, and still enjoy writing code yourself.
  • Have deep hands-on experience across the stack (frontend, backend, data, infrastructure/cloud) and a track record of architecting and shipping production-grade software, preferably with AI components (LLMs, embeddings, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents, PyTorch/TensorFlow).
  • Have experience developing AI agents and integrating them into business workflows.
  • Be on top of the latest tools, models and trends in AI-assisted software engineering. You are excellent at context engineering (incl. prompting), know when to leverage which model, and have first-hand experience with Claude Code or Cursor, and you know how to roll these practices out across a team.
  • Know how to evaluate what gets built. You can design eval sets, work with LLM-as-judge or ground-truth data, use tracing and observability tooling to find and fix regressions, and make evaluation a team habit.
  • Practice a truly agnostic approach to stack and tools: you pick the right tech for the problem, not vice versa, and can explain your choices to both engineers and business stakeholders.
  • Balance autonomy and alignment: you drive your team from idea to finished product independently, while knowing when to involve, align with or escalate to others.
  • Have the ability to thoughtfully challenge ideas and drive constructive discussions with engineers, product owners, the Chief Product Officer and business leadership.
  • Lead with humility: you create psychological safety, give and receive honest feedback, and measure your success by the success of your team.
  • Reside within ±3 hours of Central European Time (to enable effective collaboration), at best in one of our office locations in Barcelona, Berlin, Frankfurt, Leipzig, and Sevilla.
  • Full professional proficiency in English at C2 level.
  • Professional proficiency in German at C1 level.

Bonus

  • Experience building or scaling an engineering team in a startup or scale-up environment.
  • Prior experience integrating AI into SaaS business workflows, ideally in a client-facing or forward-deployed setup.
  • Familiarity with the modern AI-tooling ecosystem (agents, memory systems, vector databases, orchestration frameworks).
  • Experience working with distributed or multi-location teams.

Benefits

  • You’ll work in an international, closely knit team of high‑performers and entrepreneurial spirits.
  • Remote‑friendly + flexible work hours.
  • Excellent compensation + participation in the company through our ESOP.
  • Growth mindset: Hard skills are important — but mindset matters more. If you meet most of the requirements and you’re hungry to learn, apply anyway.

If you’re a high‑impact tech lead who thrives on autonomy, drives real results, and is passionate about applying AI to change how teams work - let’s talk. Even if you don’t check every bullet above, but you bring exceptional drive, creativity, and a growth mindset, please apply. We believe the right mindset counts more than checkboxes.

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Associate Project Management

Our Global Safety and Security team are the guardians of our marketplace, dedicated to protecting our people, assets, and reputation. From navigating complex global risks to implementing advanced security technologies and intelligence-led responses, we ensure a safe environment where our teams, partners, and customers can thrive with confidence. In this role, you'll help us manage end-to-end project lifecycles to deliver robust, compliant physical security technology initiatives across our regional operations.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Asset Protection and Safety team. We design, deploy, and maintain the security frameworks that safeguard our corporate and operational footprint.   • Govern regional compliance and quality standards, ensuring all installations adhere to local safety regulations, data protection laws, and industry best practices.

What You'll Need to Thrive Essential

  • Strong financial and project control skills, with demonstrated ability to manage budgets, track costs, and schedule delivery using methodology frameworks (Agile, Waterfall).

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of collaborating across diverse cross-functional teams, cultures, and external vendors.

Nice to Have

Active PMP, PRINCE2, or APM certification (or currently working towards one).

Vendor or platform certifications in physical security technologies (Genetec, Axis, Software House, or OpenPath). Familiarity with EMEA compliance and security standards, such as BS EN 50133 or ISO 27001.

A degree or equivalent qualification in Project Management, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

jobs.title: Professional Services Engineer - Cloudflare Implementation
jobs.description:
About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a cybersecurity and cloud services provider and a Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partner, dual certified in Application Security & Performance and Cloudflare One.

We design, implement and operate Cloudflare environments for enterprise and public-sector clients across Europe, the Gulf and Asia, with operations spanning Casablanca, Paris, Luxembourg, Dubai and Singapore.

Since July 2026, BRIXIO has been part of Equans, a Bouygues group company, combining our specialist focus and technical expertise with the scale, stability and career opportunities of a major international organisation.

The Role

As a Professional Services Engineer, you will design, build and implement Cloudflare environments for BRIXIO's French-speaking enterprise and public-sector clients and help take them successfully into production.

This is a hands-on implementation role covering onboarding, migration from existing CDN and WAF platforms, WAF and DDoS deployment, Zero Trust rollout, DNS cutovers, SASE and production hardening.

You will work within properly planned and governed client projects. The Delivery Manager owns the project plan and delivery governance, while the Principal Architect provides technical authority and owns the overall design.

Your responsibility is the build, validation and client-facing technical implementation.

The client portfolio includes French banks, industrial groups, public bodies and media organisations. You will regularly work directly with their technical teams in French, explaining what you are implementing, why particular decisions have been made and how production changes will be managed.

This is not a back-office engineering role.

We are hiring at two levels:

  • Senior Engineer: capable of owning a Cloudflare migration end to end and independently leading technical conversations with clients.
  • Mid-Level Engineer: strong network/security fundamentals and implementation experience, with the opportunity to deepen Cloudflare expertise through structured training and certification.

What You Will Do

Cloudflare Implementation & Migration

  • Configure and deploy Cloudflare environments across DNS, CDN and caching, WAF, DDoS mitigation, rate limiting, load balancing, Bot Management, Zero Trust and Access, tunnels and SASE components.
  • Deliver migrations from incumbent platforms, particularly Akamai and other CDN/WAF providers.
  • Handle rule translation, traffic cutover planning, staged deployment and rollback design.
  • Plan and execute production DNS cutovers, ensuring a validated rollback is available at every stage.
  • Build and deliver pilots and proofs of concept, from individual applications through to full production rollouts.
  • Test, validate and tune deployed environments, including cache-hit ratio, latency, WAF false positives and other client-relevant performance characteristics.

Client-Facing Technical Delivery

  • Lead technical working sessions with client teams in French, including workshops, configuration reviews, cutover rehearsals and go-live calls.
  • Explain technical decisions, risks and implementation considerations clearly to both engineers and management stakeholders.
  • Produce client-facing technical documentation in French and English, including configuration records, runbooks, cutover plans and project-closure documentation.
  • Identify and raise technical or delivery risks as soon as they become visible rather than allowing them to surface late in the project.

Working Within the Delivery Model

  • Work according to the project plan established by the Delivery Manager.
  • Provide clear and accurate progress updates and flag potential delays or blockers early.
  • Escalate architecture and design questions to the Principal Architect rather than making unapproved architectural changes during delivery.
  • Maintain accurate project timesheets and record effort against the appropriate projects.
  • Identify and communicate potential out-of-scope client requests to the Delivery Manager.
  • Deliver a structured handover into managed services at project closure, including complete documentation, runbooks and known risks, allowing the support team to operate the environment effectively from day one.

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Work with implementation engineers in Dubai and Poland, managed services teams in Morocco and the Philippines, and pre-sales and architecture teams in France.
  • Use Zoho Projects and BrixioOne as the source of truth for project tasks, documentation and reporting.
  • Contribute to BRIXIO's internal knowledge base and reusable implementation patterns and playbooks.
  • Support managed services teams with escalations requiring deeper implementation expertise.
  • Share technical knowledge across the wider delivery organisation.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Technical Foundation

You should have a strong practical understanding of:

  • DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS and certificates
  • Proxies and reverse proxies
  • Caching and CDN mechanics
  • Web application architecture
  • Origin infrastructure
  • Cloud fundamentals across AWS, Azure or GCP

You should be able to clearly explain what happens between a browser and an origin infrastructure and confidently troubleshoot problems across that path.

You will also need a solid grounding in web application security, including:

  • WAF concepts
  • OWASP Top 10
  • Bot mitigation
  • DDoS attack patterns
  • Rate limiting

You should be comfortable using technical troubleshooting tools including:

  • curl
  • dig
  • traceroute
  • Browser developer tools
  • Packet capture tools where required

You should also have scripting and automation capability using technologies such as Python, Bash or Terraform, together with experience working with REST APIs.

Experience with Cloudflare Workers is a strong advantage.

Cloudflare Experience

For the Senior position, hands-on Cloudflare implementation experience is required.

For the Mid-Level position, Cloudflare experience is a strong advantage but is not mandatory where you bring strong experience with comparable CDN, WAF or Zero Trust technologies.

Candidates coming from platforms such as Akamai or other relevant CDN/security technologies can be considered where the underlying technical foundation is strong.

BRIXIO provides access to Cloudflare University, partner-only training and funded certification to support continued development.

Delivery Experience

Senior Engineer

  • 5+ years of experience implementing network, security or cloud infrastructure for external clients.
  • Demonstrated experience owning technical delivery within client-facing projects.
  • Hands-on Cloudflare implementation experience.
  • Ability to independently lead technical client discussions and implementation activities.

Mid-Level Engineer

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in network, security or cloud environments.
  • Alternatively, strong technical support or NOC experience combined with genuine implementation exposure.
  • Strong technical fundamentals and the ability to develop deeper Cloudflare expertise.

For Both Levels

  • Experience working within a professional services, consultancy, MSP or systems integrator environment with committed project timelines.
  • Experience with production cutovers or migrations under formal change control is a significant advantage.
  • Confidence working directly with external clients.

Languages

Full professional fluency in both French and English is a hard requirement.

French is the primary working language for this portfolio. You will conduct technical workshops, participate in cutover and go-live calls, and prepare client-facing technical documentation in French.

English is required for collaboration with BRIXIO's international teams and work involving Gulf and Asian accounts.

Both French and English will be assessed during the interview process.

Working Pattern

The role operates primarily during Central European working hours.

Some client migrations and production go-lives will require planned out-of-hours presence. These windows will be agreed in advance and compensated.

The position is remote from Morocco, with collaboration through the Equans IT Hub in Casablanca and occasional travel to client sites in France and elsewhere in Europe.

How You Work

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Rigorous and methodical when working with production environments.
  • Disciplined about documenting configurations and changes as work progresses.
  • Comfortable working directly with clients, including when communicating technical risks or problems.
  • Honest about the limits of their knowledge and willing to involve the Principal Architect when appropriate.
  • Able to distinguish between genuine technical blockers and issues that simply require additional implementation time.
  • Comfortable working remotely within an international team spanning Morocco, France, the Gulf, Poland and the Philippines.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

  • Cloudflare environments go live according to plan and perform in production as expected from testing.
  • Migrations are completed without unplanned downtime and with validated rollback procedures in place.
  • Clients develop confidence in your technical judgement and delivery.
  • Technical documentation is complete enough for managed services teams to operate environments without unnecessary dependency on the implementation engineer.
  • Project effort is recorded accurately, allowing delivery performance and invoicing to be managed correctly.
  • Knowledge gained during implementations becomes reusable across future BRIXIO projects.

Why BRIXIO?

  • Join one of a select number of Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partners, working directly with Cloudflare engineering and support teams.
  • Be part of Equans and the Bouygues group, with the stability, scale and internal mobility of a major international organisation.
  • Develop genuine Cloudflare expertise through Cloudflare University, partner-only training and funded certification.
  • Work alongside a team that includes members of Cloudflare's Partner Technical Advisory Council.
  • Deliver substantial European enterprise and public-sector implementations through properly governed projects rather than ad hoc technical changes.
  • Develop towards Senior Professional Services Engineering, Solution Architecture or broader opportunities within the Equans delivery organisation.
