Responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth.

Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network.

At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.

As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business.

  • As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem.
  • You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities.
  • You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems.
  • You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability.
  • You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly.
  • You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption.
  • You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes.


Skills

  • Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus).
  • Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics.
  • Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation.
  • Business fluency in both English and German is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff. 


What we offer

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

Technical Project Manager - Propulsion Battery System (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your Mission:

As Project Manager – Propulsion Battery System, you will lead the development, integration and industrialisation of VÆRIDION's aircraft battery system and high-voltage electrical distribution. You will manage cross-functional activities across battery and HV engineering, testing, safety, certification, manufacturing, and supply chain to ensure system milestones are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with programme and airworthiness requirements.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the end-to-end battery system and HV distribution project from concept through certification and industrialisation

  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, budgets, resource forecasts, and system-level delivery roadmaps

  • Coordinate the design, development, testing, and aircraft integration of battery packs, battery management systems, HV distribution, protection, switching, cabling, and associated interfaces

  • Drive requirements reviews, architecture and design reviews, programme milestones, risk management, and change control processes

  • Track technical maturity, safety and certification evidence, project performance, and key deliverables against programme objectives

  • Manage battery, electrical component, and development partners, ensuring delivery to scope, schedule, quality, and cost targets

  • Facilitate alignment between battery, electrical, propulsion, aircraft systems, safety, certification, manufacturing, and supply chain teams

  • Support verification, validation, qualification, and certification activities, including battery safety, thermal propagation, HV protection, and system integration testing

  • Proactively identify and resolve technical, programme, supply chain, and organisational risks, with particular focus on battery safety and high-voltage interfaces

  • Provide clear status reporting, escalation, and decision support to leadership and stakeholders

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace, Electrical, Electrochemical, Mechanical, Systems Engineering, or a related field

  • Several years of project management experience in aerospace, aviation, automotive, battery technology, or another safety-critical industry

  • Proven experience managing complex multidisciplinary development projects involving battery systems, high-voltage systems, or electrical power distribution

  • Strong understanding of systems engineering, product development, verification, configuration management, and safety-critical hardware development

  • Experience coordinating engineering teams, suppliers, test facilities, and external development partners

  • Excellent planning, communication, risk management, and stakeholder management skills

  • Knowledge of lithium-ion battery systems, battery management systems, high-voltage architectures, electrical protection, thermal management, and relevant interfaces is highly desirable

  • Familiarity with aerospace certification and safety processes for batteries and high-voltage electrical systems is advantageous

  • Fluent in English; German is a plus

  • Proficiency with project management and product lifecycle management tools

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

  • Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung aus Projekten im Public Sector oder in public-nahen Branchen mit.
  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare praktische Qualifikation.
  • Du kommunizierst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und bringst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings und Zertifizierungen entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

jobs.title: AI Technical Lead - Developer Tooling
Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Senior Project Manager, you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.

At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.

You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.

We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex projects: management consulting, enterprise software implementation, or large-scale transformation delivery.

  • Proven track record running multi-country or multi-entity programs with senior client stakeholders, and steering a committee that includes client executives.

  • Experience leading a delivery team rather than only a plan.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

jobs.description:
Über die Position

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus

Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location with regular travel to client sites across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You own the client outcome on our largest strategic accounts, from the moment the contract is signed to the moment the solution is running at scale, and you carry the revenue that comes with it.

Our customers do not buy software, they buy a change in how their organization runs. Automating core processes end-to-end frees capacity that was locked in manual execution. Consolidating fragmented point solutions onto one platform lowers what the process landscape costs to own. And running those processes with full transparency gives finance something it rarely has, a reliable real-time view of what is actually happening, which is what makes forecasting and financial steering possible.

Delivering that on a strategic account takes a full blp team: a Senior Project Manager and Project Managers, Integrations Engineers and a Technical Project Manager, a Consultant with AI Automation Specialists, and our Customer Success Engineers. Your job is to make that team deliver for your customers, to hold the relationship at executive level while it happens, and to grow the account once the value is proven. You make sure a strategic customer gets what it was promised: a custom Academy for its teams, priority support, and whatever automation effort it takes to reach the productivity we committed to.

You are not managing a queue and you are not running the project plan. You carry a focused portfolio of our largest customers, and you are the one person accountable for whether they consider blp a success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own net revenue retention and expansion across a focused portfolio of our largest strategic customers.

  • Join late-stage commercial discussions, shape the delivery approach with the Account Executive, and own the client kick-off.

  • Hold the steering committee seat and the relationship with the client's CFO, COO or Head of Shared Services.

  • Act as the trusted advisor and domain expert your clients call before they call anyone else.

  • Orchestrate the functions that serve your accounts, project management, integrations, consulting and support, without managing them directly.

  • Own the value case: set the baseline at go-live, track it, and defend it in the quarterly business review.

  • Be the first point of escalation for your clients. Call a delivery review when a project is off track, require a recovery plan, and hold the organization to it.

  • Identify expansion early, new entities, new processes, new countries, and build the internal case for it.

  • Be the voice of your customers inside blp: collect and structure product feedback from your accounts, and work with Product, Engineering and Sales to translate what clients need into what gets built, without losing sight of blp's own product direction.

  • Turn your best accounts into reference customers: case studies, referenceability, and clients willing to speak publicly about blp.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Ownership Without Authority – You deliver a number that depends on people who do not report to you, and you do it without escalating.

  • Executive Presence – You hold a room where a client executive is unhappy, and you leave it with a decision rather than an action item.

  • Commercial Instinct – You see the expansion before the client asks, and you can build the business case for it.

  • Structured Thinking – You break an ambiguous client situation into a plan with owners and dates.

  • Customer-First Mentality – You care about the client's business outcome, not about defending the project scope.

What You Bring

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 6+ years of experience in strategy consulting, enterprise customer success or account leadership, or senior delivery roles with commercial accountability.

  • Proven track record of owning senior client relationships in complex, multi-stakeholder organizations.

  • Experience running steering committees and holding difficult conversations with executive sponsors.

  • Credible on enterprise finance and supply chain processes. You do not need to configure an ERP, but you need to understand how one is used.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for experience in ERP, AP automation, or AI-driven enterprise SaaS.

How You Grow

Client Partners work closest to our leadership and to our largest customers. From here the paths lead into leading a team of Client Partners, into senior commercial roles, or into leading a delivery or consulting function. Many of our Client Partners come from Senior Project Manager or Senior Consultant roles, and we are explicit about what that step requires.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

Nous accompagnons les salariés avec des sessions individuelles, une application de self-care et un outil de micro-learning intégré à Slack et Teams.

  • Obsess over users, drive adoption. Design for diverse user groups with varying levels of tech comfort, and understand how your work drives adoption.

  • Be a partner to Product and Engineering. Make trade-offs explicit, unblock decisions, and stay close through implementation so what ships matches what was intended.

  • Drive consistency through shared solutions. Work with a Senior Product Designer on cross-product problems, patterns, and reusable solutions.

You not only bring ownership, craft, and user obsession - but also bring great aesthetic taste & strong design instincts.

Bei uns entwickelst du an einer Plattform, die rechtliche Prozesse digital abbildet und automatisiert. Von der Erstellung rechtlicher Inhalte über Vertrags- und Prüfprozesse bis hin zu Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsfragen. Dazu gehören Schnittstellen und Plugins, über die unsere Inhalte in die Shopsysteme unserer Mitglieder gelangen, sowie Integrationen mit Partnersystemen. Ziel ist es, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen in verlässliche, verständliche und effiziente digitale Workflows zu überführen.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Leitung von Projekten, die wir in kleinen Projektteams umsetzen: Du konzipierst Lösungen, verantwortest die Umsetzung, leitest andere Entwickler im Projekt an und hältst alle Beteiligten über den Stand auf dem Laufenden. Kleinere Projekte setzt du eigenständig komplett um, bei größeren arbeitest du im Team mit Laravel und Livewire im Stack.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Konzeption: Analyse von Anforderungen, Entwurf der Lösungsarchitektur, Festlegung von Datenmodellen und Schnittstellen sowie Einschätzung von Aufwänden für Features und Projekte.

  • Ownership für die Umsetzung: Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Projekt von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live ankommt. Aufgaben schneiden und priorisieren, Fortschritt im Blick behalten, technische Entscheidungen treffen und Blocker aus dem Weg räumen.

  • Anleitung & Wissenstransfer: Fachliche Führung weiterer Entwickler im Projekt durch klare technische Vorgaben, Pairing und Code Reviews im Backend wie im Frontend. Wissen über Architektur und Entscheidungen landet im Team und in der Dokumentation, nicht nur bei dir.

  • Reporting: Regelmäßige, verständliche Berichte zu Stand, Risiken und nächsten Schritten an Team Lead, Product Owner und Stakeholder.

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung: Umsetzung mit Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS. Kleinere Projekte eigenständig von Anfang bis Ende, größere im Projektteam.

  • Partneranbindungen & Integrationen: Lösungsevaluierung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Schnittstellen zu Partner- und Drittsystemen.

  • Architektur & Technologie-Evaluation: Mitgestaltung von Architektur, Entwicklungsstandards und Tooling; Evaluation neuer Technologien, Frameworks und KI-Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Hinblick auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für Produkt und Team.


Dein Profil

Technisch

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PHP & Laravel: Entwicklung von Webanwendungen über den gesamten Stack, im Frontend idealerweise mit Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS.

  • Konzeption & technische Leitung: Erfahrung darin, technische Konzepte zu erarbeiten und deren Umsetzung zu verantworten, allein oder als technische Leitung eines Projektteams.

  • Code Reviews über den gesamten Stack: Praxis im Review von Backend- und Frontend-Code und die Fähigkeit, Feedback so zu geben, dass andere daran wachsen.

  • Testerfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit PHPUnit oder Pest und Erfahrung mit Teststrategien in größeren Codebasen. Tests sind für dich Teil der Umsetzung, nicht Nacharbeit.

  • Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design.

  • Agile Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, inklusive enger Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichem Austausch.


Nice to Have, aber kein Muss

  • DevOps-Erfahrung: Cloud-Systeme, PaaS-Plattformen, Container, CI/CD oder Linux-Serveradministration (z.B. DigitalOcean und Laravel Cloud)

  • Erfahrung mit Shopsystemen und der Entwicklung von Plugins oder Apps dafür (z.B. Shopify oder JTL)

  • Gespür für UX und Erfahrung in der Gestaltung benutzerfreundlicher Oberflächen

  • Erfahrung mit Event-basierten Architekturen, Queues oder asynchronen Verarbeitungsprozessen

  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von LLM-APIs in Produktfeatures (Prompting, Evaluierung, Guardrails)


Persönlich

  • Ownership: Du fühlst dich für das Ergebnis eines Projekts verantwortlich. Von der ersten Skizze bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus und nicht nur für deine eigenen Tickets.

  • Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg.

  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: Du bereitest den Stand eines Projekts für technische und nicht-technische Beteiligte verständlich auf, auch dann, wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft.

  • Pragmatismus: Du findest die Balance zwischen sauberer Lösung und pragmatischem Fortschritt.

  • Wissenstransfer: Du hast Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere im Team besser zu machen, bspw. in Reviews, Pairings und Dokumentation.

  • KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht.

jobs.title: Product Manager, New Product Bet (Principal-level)
jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

Almost any company can produce training video at scale today. Almost none can tell you whether it actually made someone better at their job. We're building the product that closes that gap: an agentic, real-time experience where people practice live, dynamic scenarios, and where organizations finally get genuine signal on readiness, instead of a metric tied to course completion. This is a zero-to-one bet on what comes after content, which is practice, and proof.

You'll own one of two of the domains inside that bet, Surveys and Guidance, from strategy through ship.

Why now

Real-time, agentic AI has only just become good enough to hold a convincing live scenario, and to make sense of what happens inside one. The window to define this category is open now, and we intend to own it.

The problem you're solving

Today, the most a company can do to check whether someone has genuinely learned something is watch them complete a module or pass a quiz. The behaviors that matter in real roles, in real moments, are rarely tested reliably, and what comes back to the business is a thin, lagging signal.

We have the underlying technology to change that. What we need is a product manager who can turn it into something an enterprise will use to prepare its people, and that an end user actually wants to engage with, across two connected domains:

  • Surveys - capturing structured, trustworthy signal at scale: how people feel, how they're performing, and where the gaps are.

  • Guidance - giving people direction in the moment they need it, live and in context, rather than as a debrief after the fact.

Both sit inside the same bet: give organizations proof of readiness, not just proof of attendance.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the multi-quarter strategy for Surveys and Guidance, setting the direction, identifying the right problems to solve, and making the trade-offs needed to deliver against them.

  • Defining and evolving the success metrics for both domains, and connecting product outcomes directly to commercial results: retention, expansion, and revenue impact.

  • Getting close to the customers who matter most: understanding how they think, where current tools leave them exposed, and translating that into a product direction others can act on.

  • Driving a shared understanding of where these product areas are going and why. Engineering, design, R&D, and commercial counterparts should all be able to articulate the strategy and the reasoning behind it.

  • Producing written narratives, strategy docs, and PRDs, that move decisions forward and give your team the context to build the right thing without a follow-up conversation.

  • Balancing short-term delivery with long-term product health: scoping to reflect execution risk, hitting milestones predictably, and iterating based on evidence rather than opinion.

  • Contributing to improvements in product practice across the team, and actively participating in PM hiring.

Who you are

You've owned a critical product domain before, one where the stakes were real and the strategy was yours to set, not just execute. You're comfortable operating with autonomy on the what, not just the how, and you have a track record of connecting product decisions to commercial outcomes.

You understand that zero-to-one products in complex domains require you to hold two things at once: the discipline to deliver predictably in the short term, and the judgment to make the right long-term bets while the evidence is still forming. You don't wait for a clean brief. You identify the right problems, form a view, and bring others along.

You're a strong written communicator. Engineering and design partners, commercial leads, and senior leadership should all come away from your docs and updates with a clear understanding of where the domain is going and why, without needing to ask.

You care about the quality of the experience. Real-time, agentic products are unforgiving, and you hold a high bar for what "good" feels like, for the user in the moment and for the customer looking at outcomes.

You may be a good fit if you bring

  • Significant experience in product management, with direct experience owning a critical product domain: setting strategy, not just executing it.

  • A track record of connecting product outcomes to commercial results: ARR, retention, expansion, or equivalent.

  • Experience with zero-to-one product development in a complex, experience-driven space. You've navigated the ambiguity of a zero-to-one build and have the scar tissue to show for it.

  • Experience building agentic or AI-powered products. You understand what makes real-time AI interactions feel natural, and what breaks them.

  • Strong written communication: strategy docs, PRDs, and decision memos that others can act on without a follow-up conversation.

  • Experience working alongside enterprise buying motions. You'll be close to the commercial team, and that context matters.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every point above. Strong candidates rarely match a list exactly, and we'd rather hear from you.

Location

Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

Our culture

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

 

Global benefits:

  • You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity.

  • You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays.

  • Regular team offsites where you’ll get to collaborate with the product & engineering team in person.

  • Work from home budget

  • Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year

  • Generous referral scheme

  • Enhanced parental leave - maternity leave includes 16 weeks at full pay, and paternity leave includes 5 weeks at full pay (if your country’s government scheme offers more generous support, you receive whichever is greater - our enhanced policy or the local statutory benefit)

 

Benefits specific to UK:

  • Private healthcare via AXA for you with a discount for dependants

  • 5% pension match

  • Team lunches Tuesday-Friday in the office

  • Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

jobs.description:

DocuWare stands for globally distributed, international teams and an open corporate culture that invites you to help shape it. Mobile Work and flexible working hours are part of our everyday life. jobs.description:
Your mission

As a Lead Frontend Engineer (m/f/d), you will be a key driver in shaping and evolving our web platform in a dynamic, technology-driven environment. You are comfortable working across architecture, hands-on development, and the continuous improvement of our applications, with a strong focus on quality, scalability, performance, and user experience.
At the intersection of Frontend Engineering, Backend, Product, and Platform, you will take technical ownership of key areas of our web platform. You will build high-performance, scalable, and user-centric solutions, actively shape our frontend architecture, and ensure sustainable technical decisions.
In this role, you will act as a technical leader and trusted sparring partner within the team. You challenge existing solutions, contribute ideas proactively, and help drive architecture, technology, and quality decisions. At the same time, you remain hands-on and work closely with the team to implement key initiatives. Your tasks:

Frontend Development & Architecture

  • Develop and maintain the frontend of our web platform using React and TypeScript
  • Contribute to architecture and design decisions for a modular and future-proof platform
  • Build reusable components, frontend modules, and backend-for-frontend solutions
  • Evolve our application architecture with a focus on maintainability, scalability, and performance
  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs using Node.js and NestJS
  • Work in an agile team with close collaboration across Product, Backend, and Platform teams
Product, Quality & Automation
  • Deliver complex use cases with a strong focus on user experience and consistency
  • Translate business and design requirements into sustainable technical solutions
  • Design and implement modern testing and quality assurance strategies
  • Conduct code reviews and continuously improve code quality and maintainability
  • Drive automation, developer experience, and engineering standards
  • Continuously optimize frontend performance and overall user experience
AI-Assisted Engineering & Innovation

  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to frontend engineers and adjacent teams

  • Facilitate technical decision-making and collaborate closely with Product Management, Backend Engineering, and Platform teams

  • You are solution-oriented and able to communicate complex technical topics in a structured way
  • You think beyond individual features and design solutions with scalability, maintainability, and user value in mind
  • You challenge architectures and processes constructively and actively seek better solutions
  • You communicate your ideas proactively and can explain technical decisions clearly
  • You take ownership and drive topics independently from concept to delivery

  • Degree in Computer Science or a comparable qualification
  • Several years of professional experience in modern web application development
  • Experience in a technical leadership or senior engineering role
  • Strong expertise in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and NestJS
  • Proven experience designing modern frontend architectures and RESTful APIs
  • Excellent understanding of modular application and system architectures
  • Experience with testing strategies, code reviews, and modern quality assurance practices
  • Experience with HTML, CSS, Sass, relational databases, and SQL
  • Experience with monorepos and modern dependency management is a plus
  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered developer tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot
  • Experience mentoring and supporting the professional growth of engineers is a plus

  • Cursor & Claude Code
Languages

  • Freedom to develop own ideas and thus make an active contribution to the success of our company
  • Attractive remuneration with variable components as part of a total compensation system
  • Great colleagues, a friendly working atmosphere and numerous employee events

jobs.description:
JOIN OUR TEAM

As a (Senior) Sustainability Manager in our Product Management team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our Sustainability Cockpit. Working at the intersection of product, regulation, and customer needs, you will drive the continued development of solutions supporting organisations in meeting evolving sustainability reporting requirements.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to translate regulatory developments and customer feedback into valuable product capabilities. If you enjoy combining sustainability expertise with product thinking and want to help customers navigate an evolving ESG landscape, we'd love to hear from you.

EQS Group is a leading international cloud software provider in the areas of Compliance & Ethics, Data Privacy, Sustainability Management, and Investor Relations. We help thousands of companies worldwide to cultivate trust by simplifying complex processes, ensuring transparency, and enabling clear communication with stakeholders.

Our success is built on our people. We bring together talented individuals who care about doing meaningful work, take pride in what they do, and support one another to achieve more together. We believe passion and trust aren’t just values — they’re at the core of how we operate, every day.

Our mission is to Create Trusted Companies. If you share our passion for our mission, we’d love to have you help us turn it into reality.


OUR CULTURE DRIVES OUR BENEFITS

  • You're important. We foster a trusting environment and lifelong learning to support your individual development. Set personal development goals, receive support and regular feedback — we give you the tools to succeed.
  • Living our values. Our values connect us. They shape how we work and collaborate across teams and cultures, creating belonging, trust, and an environment where everyone can thrive.
  • Great atmosphere. We cultivate a dynamic culture where shared goals bring us together. From unforgettable company events to volunteering initiatives, we inspire and empower each other to make a positive impact.
  • Work-life balance is a must. Enjoy a modern office with state-of-the-art equipment, flexible working hours, and a hybrid model — including the ability to work from abroad within the EU. Paid vacation is standard, and for longer breaks, we offer a sabbatical because your free time matters too.
  • Special perks just for you. We offer you other exciting benefits, such as salary optimization in the form of customized bonus and benefit programs, as well as corporate shopping benefits.
  • Health is a priority. We support your well-being with company-sponsored sports programs for the use of various fitness studios, bicycle leasing via JobRad, and mental health counseling.


YOUR IMPACT

  • Drive the further development of the EQS Sustainability Cockpit with a particular focus on CSRD, EU Taxonomy, and sustainability reporting capabilities.
  • Translate regulatory developments and market requirements into clear product priorities and requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success Management (CSM), Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver customer-centric product enhancements.
  • Act as a sustainability subject matter expert for internal stakeholders, particularly Product, Sales, and Customer Success.
  • Participate in Sales and customer meetings to answer domain-specific questions and guide prospects and customers in navigating sustainability reporting requirements.
  • Gather and evaluate customer and market feedback to continuously improve the Sustainability Cockpit.
  • Monitor developments in the European sustainability reporting landscape and assess their impact on the product roadmap.
Be part of an exciting journey and contribute to our success story of becoming the leading provider of digital compliance and governance solutions.


THIS IS YOU

Must have

  • Professional experience in sustainability, ESG reporting, or sustainable finance, ideally within a software or technology environment.
  • Strong knowledge of CSRD, EU Taxonomy, and the European sustainability reporting landscape, complemented by knowledge of additional reporting frameworks or emerging regulatory developments.
  • Experience working with cross-functional product development and customer-facing teams, supported by strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into structured product requirements.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in German (C2) and English (C1).
  • Experience with ESG or sustainability reporting software.
  • Practical experience using AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) and AI-enabled workflow automation to make sustainability research, regulatory analysis, and product documentation more efficient, with a responsible approach to data privacy and output quality.
  • Experience supporting customer conversations, product demonstrations, or go-to-market initiatives.
Nice to have
  • Familiarity with agile product development methodologies.

We are open to hiring remotely in Germany.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 20,000+ daily active users, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

 

About the role

We're looking for a driven, curious, and impact-focused Senior Account Executive to join our growing team. You'll play a key role in driving revenue growth across mid-market and enterprise accounts by helping organizations automate their ERP processes with AI. At blp, you'll take full ownership of the sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation and close, and directly shape how the next generation of companies operates.

You'll engage with senior decision-makers (CFOs, CIOs, CPOs, COOs) to uncover challenges, design tailored solutions, and position blp's platform as a strategic enabler of efficiency and insight. You'll work closely with marketing, product, and customer success to deliver exceptional value throughout the customer journey.

 

What you'll own

Pipeline creation and territory strategy

  • Build and execute a territory/account plan: target accounts, stakeholders, sequencing, and multi-threading strategy.

  • Create net-new pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner motion, events, and customer referrals.

  • Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene and forecasting, and report proactively on progress, risks, and what you need from the organization.

Insight-led selling and deal shaping

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing and introduce a sharper point of view on where value is trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls).

  • Run executive discovery to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate it into a crisp target-state narrative, urgency, and mutual action plan.

  • Build internal alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees, including champions, economic buyers, IT/security, and process owners.

Commercial ownership: value case, negotiation, and close

  • Own the business case, pricing strategy, proposals, negotiation, and contracting.

  • Quantify and communicate value (capacity release, cycle time reduction, control/compliance improvements, stack simplification) and tie it to executive priorities and budget.

  • Drive the deal to closure with clear next steps, strong deal governance, and accurate forecasting.

Orchestration across presales and delivery

  • Partner with Solutions Engineers to run workshops/demos and de-risk technical concerns (security, integration, rollout).

  • Align with Customer Success on implementation readiness, success criteria, and expansion paths.

  • Ensure clean handoffs from close to kickoff, maintaining continuity of value narrative and outcomes.

Competitive positioning

  • Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

  • Anticipate and neutralize competitive plays with crisp differentiation and proof.

 

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 5–10+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS selling experience (or equivalent complex solution sales), with a consistent track record of hitting/exceeding targets.

  • Proven ability to run insight-led enterprise sales cycles: you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and mobilize buying committees.

  • Strong executive presence with CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services and comfort navigating enterprise procurement.

  • Ability to manage complex, multi-threaded deals: mutual action plans, MEDDICC-style qualification, forecasting discipline.

  • Strong collaboration with presales/SE and post-sales teams; you sell what can be delivered.

Strong plus

  • ERP/SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or selling into finance/procurement/shared services transformations.

  • Experience selling automation platforms (workflow/RPA/process mining/IDP) and winning against incumbents.

  • Experience with global enterprise rollouts and multi-country stakeholders.

Language

  • Fluent in English and German (or another major European language depending on territory).

 

What you'll get

  • A product that wins. blp's solution consistently outperforms competitors. Your job is to open more doors.

  • Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

  • Real ownership. Choose annually to take your variable compensation in cash or company shares.

  • Growth and autonomy. Build your own success path in a rapidly scaling, internationally expanding company.

  • Continuous learning. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching to help you excel.

  • Exceptional team. Join a group of ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to achieve excellence.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

jobs.description:
Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Luxembourg office.

About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.
If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What you'll be doing

As our Legal Counsel, you'll provide high-level legal guidance within the Fintech sector, particularly in payments, e-money, and consumer credit products, offering strategic counsel on regulatory, contractual, and product-related matters to ensure compliance and mitigate risks.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Product development support – Collaborate cross-functionally to design and launch new products and services in Payments and Consumer Credit (such as BNPL), integrating basic technical and engineering considerations into legal analysis.

  • Risk assessment & management – Identify legal and regulatory risks, proposing effective mitigation strategies aligned with our risk appetite to safeguard the organisation.

  • Regulatory compliance – Advise on relevant financial regulatory requirements, including PSD2, AML/KYC, e-money regulations, and CCD2, ensuring adherence.

  • Stakeholder management – Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, providing pragmatic legal guidance and fostering a culture of legal awareness across the organisation.

Who we're looking for

This role needs someone strategic, analytically strong, and equipped with deep fintech and payments regulatory knowledge to navigate complex legal frameworks.

  • Relevant education – Qualified lawyer with a minimum of 5 years PQE, and ideally 8–10 years of professional legal experience.

  • Relevant technical and regulatory knowledge – Deep knowledge of financial and consumer credit regulations (PSD2, AML/KYC, EMRs, CCD2) and a demonstrable track record in Fintech and Payments, ideally with experience in both private practice and in-house settings.

  • Analytical mindset – Ability to dive deep into complex legal issues, exercise strong judgment, and make sound risk-based decisions.

  • Technical and commercial awareness – Clear understanding of basic technology and engineering processes in Fintech, Payments, and consumer lending, with prior experience working with technical teams being a significant plus; ability to balance legal risks with commercial considerations.

  • Language fluency – English fluency (both written and spoken) is essential, while knowledge of Italian or French is a plus for effective communication within our international context.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

  • ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

  • 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

  • ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

  • 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.

*We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

Equal opportunity employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.

Senior Account Manager (French-speaking)
jobs.description:
Who are we

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. We do not partner with search firms.

 

About the Team

We are looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our EMEA team, which focuses on strengthening relationships with existing customers and driving sustainable revenue growth through retention, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.

In this role, you will own the commercial outcomes and full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts. This includes protecting customer retention, supporting successful renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring customers continue to realise value from Lokalise over time.

You will manage a portfolio of strategic customers, with a particular focus on French-speaking stakeholders and organisations. You will act as a trusted commercial partner, helping customers connect Lokalise's capabilities to their business objectives, localisation workflows, and international growth plans.

You will report to the Director of Sales EMEA and work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, Finance, and Legal. You will be measured primarily on account expansion through upselling, cross-selling, and broader customer adoption and gross revenue retention across your portfolio .

 

What You Will Do

  • Own account commercial outcomes: Take responsibility for the full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.
  • Protect retention and renewal outcomes: Monitor account health, customer engagement, product value, and commercial risks to identify potential retention challenges early and coordinate effective action with internal teams.

The work potentially spans AI agents and copilots, deterministic automation, RAG systems, and the data infrastructure they rely on.   • Work with stakeholders across Compliance, Trading, Operations, Legal, Sales, and Finance to identify, scope, and prioritize use cases that genuinely move the needle.

  • Maintain prompt and skill libraries as reusable, version-controlled assets, not as one-off scripts. 

AI Governance and Inventory 

  • Maintain the firm-wide inventory of AI systems and use cases, including those built outside D&A. 
  • Run the operational side of the company’s AI approval process: documentation, risk classification, model cards, evaluation artifacts. Policy is set at the executive level; you make sure the operational practice meets it. 
  • Conduct technical review of new AI initiatives proposed elsewhere in the company; advise on scope, risk, and design choices. 

Data Engineering and Platform 

  • Contribute to ELT pipelines on the Dagster + SQLMesh + dlt stack, primarily where AI & automation use cases require new data sources or transformations. 
  • Build the data substrate that AI workloads consume; feature views, document indexes, and structured event tables.  
  • Maintain infrastructure as code in Git with proper review and deployment standards. 

 

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of relevant experience. We are flexible on title, could be AI engineer, analytics engineer with AI focus, or data engineer who is pivoted to AI. What matters is shipped work. 
  • Demonstrable production experience with LLM applications: at minimum structured extraction with LLMs, and agentic patterns (tool use, multi-step workflows). You can describe what failed and what you learned. 
  • Strong Python; comfortable building production ready code, not just notebooks. 
  • Working knowledge of evaluation discipline for LLM applications (eval sets, regression tests, observability), conceptual understanding of retrieval, and how to handle hallucination. 
  • Familiarity with at least one orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and one transformation framework (SQLMesh, dbt). 
  • Solid SQL (window functions, joins, query design). 
  • Cloud experience, ideally GCP and BigQuery. 
  • Genuine curiosity about regulated environments and the discipline they require. 
  • Professional proficiency in English (German is a plus). 
  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss permit or EU/EFTA citizenship). 

Equally important is how you think: 

  • You reach for the simplest thing that works. Boring SQL before vector search. Rules before agents. You can explain why. 
  • You are comfortable saying "this is not an AI problem" when the right answer is a dashboard, a process fix, or a deterministic script. 
  • You can run a stakeholder workshop and write production code in the same week. 
  • You take documentation, evaluation, and audit trails seriously, not as overhead. 

Nice to have: 

  • Prior exposure to regulated financial services, crypto, or comparable model-risk environments. 

What we are not looking for:

  • Pure data engineers using this posting to pivot into AI without prior LLM work. 
  • Strategists or generalist "AI enthusiasts." This is a builder role. 

Benefits

  • Shape the future of finance while working at the cutting edge of B2B digital asset solutions

Our culture

jobs.title: AI Systems Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.


Position description

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance.

This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several.

While Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian suite form a core part of your platform footprint, your scope extends well beyond it: you will build and maintain integrations across our enterprise tool stack, engineer automation pipelines that eliminate manual work at scale, and operationalize AI-native capabilities (Enterprise Apps connectors, Claude MCP integrations, Rovo agents) that put Sonar ahead of the curve in AI-driven internal operations.

Your success will directly enable every internal team at Sonar to work faster, smarter, and with less friction — and will give leadership real-time visibility, consistent governance, and a platform that scales effortlessly with the company's global growth.


What you will do

You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations.

You bring proven, multi-year experience in:

  • AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. You prototype on the frontier, then harden what works into reliable, governed production systems that internal teams depend on daily.

  • ITSM Platform Ownership (JSM): Administering, configuring, and continuously evolving Jira Service Management — including service catalog design, SLA management, queue configuration, request type rationalization, and automated routing. You treat JSM as a product, not a ticket system.

  • Atlassian Suite Administration: Managing the full Atlassian Cloud ecosystem (Jira Software, Confluence, JSM, Guard, Loom, Trello, Bitbucket) with deep expertise in governance, user access management, project templates, and platform health monitoring.

  • Automation Engineering: Designing and implementing sophisticated workflow automations — using Atlassian Automation, REST APIs, and third-party middleware — that eliminate manual processes and scale operations without adding headcount.

  • Enterprise Integration Architecture: Building and maintaining integrations between Atlassian and adjacent enterprise systems (Slack, HR platforms, identity providers, monitoring tools) using webhooks, APIs, and marketplace apps.

  • CMDB & Asset Management: Owning JSM Assets configuration, data integrity, and lifecycle management across IT hardware, software licenses, and configuration items (CIs) — ensuring a reliable, audit-ready source of truth.

  • ITSM Process Governance: Defining and enforcing ITIL-aligned processes including incident management, change management, problem management, and access management — translating business needs into governed, automated workflows.

  • Security, Compliance & Audit Support: Ensuring platform configurations adhere to SonarSource's data protection, access control, and audit requirements. Supporting external audit engagements (KPMG, PwC) with documentation and evidence packages.

  • Stakeholder Enablement: Partnering with all internal teams (HR, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, GTM) to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and deliver continuous improvements — acting as a true internal platform consultant.

  • Platform Roadmap Contribution: Proactively identifying opportunities to modernize internal processes, adopt new platform capabilities, and drive the platform roadmap forward in partnership with the BizTech BackOffice lead


    • Experience and qualifications

    Experience & Technical Acumen

  • AI Engineering (Required): Hands-on experience with AI-native platforms and building on them — Claude/Anthropic, MCP, agent frameworks (Rovo or equivalent), connectors, and prompt-based workflows. You've built and shipped something real, not just experimented.

  • Atlassian Platform Expertise (Required): 5+ years hands-on administration of Jira Service Management (JSM), Jira Software, and Confluence Cloud in enterprise, multi-team environments. Deep knowledge of JSM request types, workflows, SLAs, queues, automations, and service catalog design.

  • Automation & Integration Engineering: Proven experience building workflow automations using Atlassian Automation and/or third-party tools. Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON for system integrations. Scripting experience (Python, Groovy, JavaScript) is a strong plus.

  • Enterprise Tool Breadth: Experience with adjacent enterprise systems — identity providers (Okta, JumpCloud), collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom), or business systems (NetSuite, BambooHR, Salesforce) — is a strong differentiator. We don't need deep expertise in all of them, but curiosity and adaptability across the stack matters.

  • CMDB / Asset Management: Experience configuring and maintaining a CMDB or IT asset management system (JSM Assets, ServiceNow CMDB, or equivalent).

  • ITSM & ITIL Knowledge: Strong understanding of ITSM processes and ITIL v3/v4 frameworks — including incident, change, problem, and request management — with the ability to configure platform workflows that enforce these processes at scale.

  • Security & Compliance Awareness: Understanding of IT General Controls (ITGC), access governance, and audit-readiness requirements. Experience supporting external audit engagements is a plus.

  • Atlassian Certifications (Plus): ACP-620 (Jira Service Management), ACP-120 (Jira Administrator), or ACP-420 (Confluence Administrator) are highly valued.

    • Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities — you see patterns others miss and turn complexity into clean solutions.

  • Highly autonomous and pragmatic: you make concrete progress in the face of ambiguity and imperfect information, without waiting for perfect requirements.

  • Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize across competing demands and manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

  • Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo — and to give and receive direct feedback in the service of continuous improvement.

  • Excellent communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Fluent in English, written and verbal.

  • Collaborative by nature: you share information and ideas freely, and you understand that the best solutions emerge from collective thinking.

  • Leadership mindset: you take ownership of initiatives end-to-end and drive them to completion with accountability and autonomy.

  • Values "done" over "perfect" — while continuously looking for ways to improve processes and deliver measurable impact.

    • In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

    Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.
